Class XmlWType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlWType
public class XmlWType extends Object
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://talkbank.org/manuals/CHAT.html#Linkages">CHAT manual section on this
                     topic...</a>

Java class for wType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="wType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}langs" minOccurs="0"/>
         <choice maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0">
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}ca-delimiter"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}ca-element"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}long-feature"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}overlap-point"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}p"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}shortening"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}wk"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}pos"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}replacement"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}italic"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}underline"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}mor"/>
         </choice>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}mod" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}pho" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="user-special-form" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}string" />
       <attribute name="formSuffix" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}string" />
       <attribute name="formType" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}wordFormType" />
       <attribute name="type" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}wordType" />
       <attribute name="untranscribed" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}untranscribedType" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getContent

      public List<Serializable> getContent()
       <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://talkbank.org/manuals/CHAT.html#Linkages">CHAT manual section on this
                     topic...</a>
      Gets the value of the content property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the content property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getContent().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list JAXBElement<XmlLangsType> JAXBElement<XmlCaDelimiterType> JAXBElement<XmlCaElementType> JAXBElement<XmlLongFeatureType> JAXBElement<XmlOverlapPointType> JAXBElement<XmlProsodyType> JAXBElement<XmlShorteningType> JAXBElement<XmlCompoundType> JAXBElement<XmlPosType> JAXBElement<XmlReplacementType> JAXBElement<XmlItalicType> JAXBElement<XmlUnderlineType> JAXBElement<XmlMorType> JAXBElement<XmlPhoneticTranscriptionType> JAXBElement<XmlPhoneticTranscriptionType> String
